1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-verify — computational checks (format, lint, test) for harness workers.
     6	#
     7	#   harness-verify detect                 print resolved commands as JSON
     8	#   harness-verify format [file]          PostToolUse hook (reads hook JSON on stdin if no file)
     9	#   harness-verify stop                   Stop hook (reads hook JSON on stdin)
    10	#   harness-verify done ROLE              Stop hook, no checks: only the report gate
    11	#   harness-verify run [lint|test|all]    manual / reviewer: exit 0 pass, 1 fail
    12	#   harness-verify baseline [agent]       record the start state (harness ask calls it)
    13	#
    14	# Never blocks a worker because of its own prerequisites: jq missing, not a git
    15	# repo, or no config all exit 0 (with at most one stderr line).
    16	set -u
    17	
    18	# Shared role list from lib/harness-defaults.sh, sourced eagerly (see bin/harness). This is a
    19	# Stop hook: a missing lib must never fail it, so fall back to the literal list below.
    20	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    21	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
    22	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
    23	  src=$(readlink "$src")
    24	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
    25	done
    26	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
    27	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
    28	if ! . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-defaults.sh" 2>/dev/null; then
    29	  HARNESS_ROLES="analyst implementer reviewer"
    30	  role_in() { case " ${2-$HARNESS_ROLES} " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
    31	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-defaults.sh not found; using the built-in role list" >&2
    32	fi
    33	. "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    34	  harness_root() { return 1; }
    35	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-root.sh not found; root = cwd" >&2
    36	}
    37	unset src d
    38	# end loader
    39	
    40	warn() { echo "harness-verify: $*" >&2; }
    41	
    42	if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    43	  warn "jq not found, skipping"
    44	  exit 0
    45	fi
    46	
    47	STATE_REL=".harness/verify"
    48	IS_GIT=0
    49	ROOT=$PWD
    50	HOOK_CWD=$PWD
    51	AGENT=implementer
    52	STEP_OUT=""
    53	RAN=0
    54	
    55	# enter_root [dir] — cd to the harness root of dir (hook stdin cwd, else the process cwd)
    56	# via harness_root (lib/harness-root.sh); no root found: stay at the cwd. Sets HOOK_CWD,
    57	# IS_GIT and ROOT. bin/harness keeps .harness/ in the conductor's cwd, which may be a
    58	# repo subdir; a worker that ended its turn deeper (cd src) must still land on that same .harness/.
    59	enter_root() {
    60	  local r
    61	  [ -z "${1:-}" ] || cd "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    62	  HOOK_CWD=$(pwd -P)
    63	  if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then IS_GIT=1; else IS_GIT=0; fi
    64	  r=$(harness_root "$HOOK_CWD") && cd "$r" 2>/dev/null || true
    65	  ROOT=$(pwd -P)
    66	}
    67	
    68	# set_agent NAME — only plain names are used in state file paths
    69	set_agent() {
    70	  case "${1:-}" in
    71	    ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;;
    72	    *) AGENT=$1 ;;
    73	  esac
    74	}
    75	
    76	# --- config --------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	
    78	# cfg_get KEY -> prints the JSON value from the first config file that has KEY
    79	cfg_get() {
    80	  local f
    81	  for f in .harness/verify.local.json .claude/harness.json; do
    82	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    83	    if jq -e --arg k "$1" 'type == "object" and has($k)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    84	      jq -c --arg k "$1" '.[$k]' "$f"
    85	      return 0
    86	    fi
    87	  done
    88	  return 1
    89	}
    90	
    91	# resolve_step KEY -> command string, or nothing when the step is disabled/absent
    92	# (explicit config only: no language or project-type detection)
    93	resolve_step() {
    94	  local v
    95	  if v=$(cfg_get "$1"); then
    96	    printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r 'if type == "string" then . else empty end'
    97	  fi
    98	}
    99	
   100	max_attempts() {
   101	  local v
   102	  v=$(cfg_get maxAttempts 2>/dev/null)
   103	  case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) v=3 ;; esac
   104	  echo "$v"
   105	}
   106	
   107	cmd_detect() {
   108	  local f l t a m
   109	  f=$(resolve_step format); l=$(resolve_step lint); t=$(resolve_step test)
   110	  a=$(cfg_get app 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$a" ] || a=null
   111	  m=$(max_attempts)
   112	  if [ -z "$f$l$t" ] && [ "$a" = null ]; then
   113	    warn "nothing configured: put {\"test\": \"...\"} in .claude/harness.json (or .harness/verify.local.json)"
   114	  fi
   115	  jq -n -c --arg f "$f" --arg l "$l" --arg t "$t" --argjson a "$a" --argjson m "$m" '
   116	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   117	    {format: ($f | nz), lint: ($l | nz), test: ($t | nz), app: $a, maxAttempts: $m}'
   118	}
   119	
   120	# --- files ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   121	
   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
   124	changed_files() {
   125	  local base=${1:-} f
   126	  [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ] || return 0
   127	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   128	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=HEAD
   129	  { git -c core.quotepath=off diff --relative --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   130	    git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   131	  } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do
   132	    [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"
   133	  done
   134	}
   135	
   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
   145	change_class() {
   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }
   150	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo code; return; }
   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)
   152	  # prefix of ROOT (the cwd) inside the toplevel: "" at the top, "pkg/" in a subdir
   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)
   154	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   156	    any=1
   157	    case "$f" in
   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;
   160	      *) echo code; return ;;
   161	    esac
   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
   165	EOF_PATHS
   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
   168	}
   169	
   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
   171	harness_bin() {
   172	  local s=${BASH_SOURCE[0]} d
   173	  while [ -h "$s" ]; do
   174	    d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd); s=$(readlink "$s")
   175	    case "$s" in /*) ;; *) s="$d/$s" ;; esac
   176	  done
   177	  d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd)
   178	  if [ -x "$d/harness" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$d/harness"; else command -v harness; fi
   179	}
   180	
   181	# quote_files -> stdin lines to one shell-quoted, space-separated string
   182	quote_files() {
   183	  local f out=""
   184	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   185	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   186	    out="$out $(printf '%q' "$f")"
   187	  done
   188	  printf '%s' "${out# }"
   189	}
   190	
   191	# expand_files CMD QUOTED -> CMD with every {files} replaced
   192	expand_files() {
   193	  local c=$1 q=$2 tok='{files}' out=""
   194	  while :; do
   195	    case "$c" in
   196	      *"$tok"*) out="$out${c%%"$tok"*}$q"; c=${c#*"$tok"} ;;
   197	      *) break ;;
   198	    esac
   199	  done
   200	  printf '%s' "$out$c"
   201	}
   202	
   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
   204	
   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
   208	run_step() {
   209	  local cmd q rc
   210	  STEP_OUT=""
   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")
   212	  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 0
   213	  case "$cmd" in
   214	    *'{files}'*)
   215	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "${2:-}" | quote_files)
   216	      [ -n "$q" ] || return 0
   217	      cmd=$(expand_files "$cmd" "$q") ;;
   218	  esac
   219	  RAN=1
   220	  STEP_OUT=$(/bin/bash -c "$cmd" </dev/null 2>&1)
   221	  rc=$?
   222	  return $rc
   223	}
   224	
   225	tail40() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | tail -n 40; }
   226	
   227	cmd_run() {
   228	  local what=${1:-all} files="" rc=0 ran_any=0 baseref=main mb="" explicit=0
   229	  case "$what" in lint|test|all) shift ;; --*) what=all ;; *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;; esac
   230	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   231	    case "$1" in
   232	      --base) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { warn "--base needs a ref"; exit 1; }; baseref=$2; explicit=1; shift 2 ;;
   233	      *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;;
   234	    esac
   235	  done
   236	  enter_root
   237	  if [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ]; then
   238	    if [ "$explicit" = 0 ] && ! git rev-parse --verify -q "$baseref^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   239	      baseref=master
   240	    fi
   241	    mb=$(git merge-base "$baseref" HEAD 2>/dev/null) || mb=""
   242	    if [ -z "$mb" ]; then
   243	      warn "base ref '$baseref' does not resolve (use --base <ref>)"
   244	      exit 2
   245	    fi
   246	  fi
   247	  files=$(changed_files "$mb")
   248	  [ -n "$files" ] || warn "no changed files versus $baseref"
   249	  if [ "$what" = lint ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   250	    RAN=0
   251	    run_step lint "$files" || rc=1
   252	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== lint ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   253	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   254	  fi
   255	  if [ "$what" = test ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   256	    RAN=0
   257	    run_step test "$files" || rc=1
   258	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== test ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   259	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   260	  fi
   261	  [ "$ran_any" -eq 1 ] || echo "harness-verify: nothing to run"
   262	  exit 0
   263	}
   264	
   265	# --- state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   266	
   267	# state_id -> HEAD sha and a hash of the working tree changes (outside .harness/)
   268	state_id() {
   269	  local head h
   270	  head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   271	  h=$({ git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   272	        git diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   273	        git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' | while IFS= read -r f; do
   274	          printf '%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
   275	        done; } 2>/dev/null | cksum)
   276	  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$head" "$h"
   277	}
   278	
   279	write_result() { # status step tail attempts
   280	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   281	  jq -n -c --arg s "$1" --arg st "$2" --arg t "$3" --argjson a "${4:-0}" \
   282	    '{status: $s, attempts: $a, step: $st, tail: $t}' > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json"
   283	}
   284	
   285	cmd_baseline() {
   286	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   287	  enter_root
   288	  # after a verify FAIL keep the original .base: the next ask must still compare
   289	  # against the tree the failing work started from
   290	  local prev=""
   291	  prev=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json" 2>/dev/null)
   292	  rm -f "${STATE_REL:?}/${AGENT:?}.json" ".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md.pending"
   293	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   294	    warn "not a git repo, no baseline"
   295	    exit 0
   296	  fi
   297	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   298	  if [ "$prev" != fail ] || [ ! -s "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ]; then
   299	    state_id > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base"
   300	  fi
   301	  echo 0 > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   302	  exit 0
   303	}
   304	
   305	# --- hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   306	
   307	# cmd_done ROLE — Stop hook for workers without verification (analyst, reviewer): the report gate only
   308	cmd_done() {
   309	  local input
   310	  input=$(cat)
   311	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   312	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   313	  report_gate
   314	  exit 0
   315	}
   316	
   317	# cmd_stop — verification Stop hook: runs the checks and prints their block decision, if any.
   318	cmd_stop() {
   319	  local input out
   320	  input=$(cat)
   321	  # the verification runs in a subshell (it exits through many paths)
   322	  out=$(STOP_INPUT=$input stop_body)
   323	  [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"
   324	  exit 0
   325	}
   326	
   327	# report_gate — a harness ask must end with a fresh report: block the stop (at most twice per ask)
   328	# so the worker writes it instead of the ask exiting 3. `[no-report]` opts out, as a marker only: at the
   329	# start of the instruction, or on a line of its own in the brief the instruction points at.
   330	report_gate() {
   331	  local a=.harness/asks/$AGENT id n brief rep=.harness/reports/$AGENT.md
   332	  case "$AGENT" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
   333	  [ -f "$a.current" ] || return 0
   334	  case "$(head -n 1 "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null)" in '[no-report]'*) return 0 ;; esac
   335	  # an instruction that only says "Read .harness/<brief>.md and do it": the opt-out may sit in the brief
   336	  brief=$(sed -n 's/.*Read \(\.harness\/[^ ]*\.md\).*/\1/p' "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   337	  case "$brief" in ''|*..*) ;; *) grep -qx '[[:space:]]*\[no-report\][[:space:]]*' "$brief" 2>/dev/null && return 0 ;; esac
   338	  [ -f "$rep" ] && [ ! "$rep" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   339	  [ -f "$rep.pending" ] && [ ! "$rep.pending" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   340	  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' "$a.current")
   341	  n=$(awk -v i="$id" '$1==i { print $2 }' "$a.reportblocks" 2>/dev/null)
   342	  case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac
   343	  [ "$n" -lt 2 ] || return 0
   344	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" $((n + 1)) > "$a.reportblocks"
   345	  jq -n -c --arg r "write .harness/reports/$AGENT.md for this ask (the report contract in your prompt), then stop" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   346	  exit 0
   347	}
   348	
   349	stop_body() {
   350	  local input=$STOP_INPUT attempts max files step="" out reason rep pend cls hb
   351	  set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   352	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   353	  report_gate
   354	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   355	    exit 0
   356	  fi
   357	  if [ -f "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ] && [ "$(state_id)" = "$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base")" ]; then
   358	    write_result skipped "" "" 0
   359	    exit 0
   360	  fi
   361	  # hide the report while verifying so `harness ask/report` never sees an unverified one
   362	  rep=".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md"; pend="$rep.pending"
   363	  [ ! -f "$rep" ] || mv -f "$rep" "$pend"
   364	  attempts=$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts" 2>/dev/null)
   365	  case "$attempts" in ''|*[!0-9]*) attempts=0 ;; esac
   366	  max=$(max_attempts)
   367	  files=$(changed_files)
   368	
   369	  RAN=0
   370	  cls=$(change_class)
   371	  if [ "$cls" = wiki ]; then
   372	    # docs/wiki changed: only the wiki checks run, no lint / test suite
   373	    hb=$(harness_bin)
   374	    if [ -n "$hb" ] && ! out=$("$hb" wiki-lint 2>&1); then step=wiki-lint; fi
   375	    if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   376	      [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   377	      write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   378	      exit 0
   379	    fi
   380	  elif [ "$cls" = docs-only ]; then
   381	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   382	    write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   383	    exit 0
   384	  elif ! run_step lint "$files"; then
   385	    step=lint; out=$STEP_OUT
   386	  elif ! run_step test "$files"; then
   387	    step=test; out=$STEP_OUT
   388	  fi
   389	  if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   390	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   391	    if [ "$RAN" -eq 1 ]; then write_result pass "" "" "$attempts"; else write_result skipped "" "" "$attempts"; fi
   392	    exit 0
   393	  fi
   394	  out=$(tail40 "$out")
   395	  if [ "$attempts" -lt "$max" ]; then
   396	    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
   397	    echo "$attempts" > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   398	    rm -f "$pend"
   399	    write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   400	    reason=$(printf 'Verification failed at step %s (attempt %s of %s). Last output:\n%s\n\nFix the cause and finish again; then rewrite the report.' "$step" "$attempts" "$max" "$out")
   401	    jq -n -c --arg r "$reason" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   402	    exit 0
   403	  fi
   404	  # cap reached: keep the worker's final report so `harness ask` exits 5 with it
   405	  [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   406	  write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   407	  exit 0
   408	}
   409	
   410	cmd_format() {
   411	  local input="" file="${1:-}" tool cwd q out fcmd lcmd d
   412	  if [ -z "$file" ]; then
   413	    input=$(cat)
   414	    tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   415	    case "$tool" in
   416	      Edit|Write|MultiEdit) ;;
   417	      *) exit 0 ;;
   418	    esac
   419	    file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   420	    cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   421	    set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   422	  else
   423	    cwd=""
   424	  fi
   425	  enter_root "$cwd"
   426	  [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0
   427	  case "$file" in
   428	    /*)
   429	      # compare physical paths (macOS /var -> /private/var)
   430	      d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${file%/*}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0
   431	      file="$d/${file##*/}"
   432	      case "$file" in
   433	        "$ROOT"/*) file=${file#"$ROOT"/} ;;
   434	        *) exit 0 ;;
   435	      esac ;;
   436	  esac
   437	  case "$file" in .harness/*|.git/*|*/../*|../*) exit 0 ;; esac
   438	  [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
   439	  fcmd=$(resolve_step format)
   440	  if [ -n "$fcmd" ]; then
   441	    case "$fcmd" in
   442	      *'{files}'*)
   443	        q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   444	        fcmd=$(expand_files "$fcmd" "$q") ;;
   445	    esac
   446	    [ -z "$fcmd" ] || /bin/bash -c "$fcmd" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   447	  fi
   448	  lcmd=$(resolve_step lint)
   449	  case "$lcmd" in
   450	    *'{files}'*)
   451	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   452	      lcmd=$(expand_files "$lcmd" "$q")
   453	      if ! out=$(/bin/bash -c "$lcmd" </dev/null 2>&1); then
   454	        out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -n 40)
   455	        jq -n -c --arg r "$(printf 'Lint failed for %s:\n%s' "$file" "$out")" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   456	      fi ;;
   457	  esac
   458	  exit 0
   459	}
   460	
   461	case "${1:-}" in
   462	  detect)   enter_root; cmd_detect ;;
   463	  format)   shift; cmd_format "$@" ;;
   464	  stop)     cmd_stop ;;
   465	  done)     shift; cmd_done "$@" ;;
   466	  run)      shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
   467	  baseline) shift; cmd_baseline "$@" ;;
   468	  *)
   469	    echo "usage: harness-verify detect | format [file] | stop | done ROLE | run [lint|test|all] | baseline [agent]" >&2
   470	    exit 1 ;;
   471	esac
   472	exit $?
   473	}

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-verify — computational checks (format, lint, test) for harness workers.
     6	#
     7	#   harness-verify detect                 print resolved commands as JSON
     8	#   harness-verify format [file]          PostToolUse hook (reads hook JSON on stdin if no file)
     9	#   harness-verify stop                   Stop hook (reads hook JSON on stdin)
    10	#   harness-verify done ROLE              Stop hook, no checks: only the report gate
    11	#   harness-verify run [lint|test|all]    manual / reviewer: exit 0 pass, 1 fail
    12	#   harness-verify baseline [agent]       record the start state (harness ask calls it)
    13	#
    14	# Never blocks a worker because of its own prerequisites: jq missing, not a git
    15	# repo, or no config all exit 0 (with at most one stderr line).
    16	set -u
    17	
    18	# Shared role list from lib/harness-defaults.sh, sourced eagerly (see bin/harness). This is a
    19	# Stop hook: a missing lib must never fail it, so fall back to the literal list below.
    20	src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    21	while [ -L "$src" ]; do
    22	  case $src in */*) d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${src%/*}" && pwd) ;; *) d=$PWD ;; esac
    23	  src=$(readlink "$src")
    24	  case $src in /*) ;; *) src=$d/$src ;; esac
    25	done
    26	case $src in */*) d=${src%/*} ;; *) d=. ;; esac   # no dirname: PATH may be bare in hooks/tests
    27	HARNESS_LIB=${HARNESS_LIB:-$(CDPATH= cd -P "$d/../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)}
    28	if ! . "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-defaults.sh" 2>/dev/null; then
    29	  HARNESS_ROLES="analyst implementer reviewer"
    30	  role_in() { case " ${2-$HARNESS_ROLES} " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
    31	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-defaults.sh not found; using the built-in role list" >&2
    32	fi
    33	. "$HARNESS_LIB/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    34	  harness_root() { return 1; }
    35	  echo "harness-verify: lib/harness-root.sh not found; root = cwd" >&2
    36	}
    37	unset src d
    38	# end loader
    39	
    40	warn() { echo "harness-verify: $*" >&2; }
    41	
    42	if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    43	  warn "jq not found, skipping"
    44	  exit 0
    45	fi
    46	
    47	STATE_REL=".harness/verify"
    48	IS_GIT=0
    49	ROOT=$PWD
    50	HOOK_CWD=$PWD
    51	AGENT=implementer
    52	STEP_OUT=""
    53	RAN=0
    54	
    55	# enter_root [dir] — cd to the harness root of dir (hook stdin cwd, else the process cwd)
    56	# via harness_root (lib/harness-root.sh); no root found: stay at the cwd. Sets HOOK_CWD,
    57	# IS_GIT and ROOT. bin/harness keeps .harness/ in the conductor's cwd, which may be a
    58	# repo subdir; a worker that ended its turn deeper (cd src) must still land on that same .harness/.
    59	enter_root() {
    60	  local r
    61	  [ -z "${1:-}" ] || cd "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
    62	  HOOK_CWD=$(pwd -P)
    63	  if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ]; then IS_GIT=1; else IS_GIT=0; fi
    64	  r=$(harness_root "$HOOK_CWD") && cd "$r" 2>/dev/null || true
    65	  ROOT=$(pwd -P)
    66	}
    67	
    68	# set_agent NAME — only plain names are used in state file paths
    69	set_agent() {
    70	  case "${1:-}" in
    71	    ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;;
    72	    *) AGENT=$1 ;;
    73	  esac
    74	}
    75	
    76	# --- config --------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	
    78	# cfg_get KEY -> prints the JSON value from the first config file that has KEY
    79	cfg_get() {
    80	  local f
    81	  for f in .harness/verify.local.json .claude/harness.json; do
    82	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    83	    if jq -e --arg k "$1" 'type == "object" and has($k)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    84	      jq -c --arg k "$1" '.[$k]' "$f"
    85	      return 0
    86	    fi
    87	  done
    88	  return 1
    89	}
    90	
    91	# resolve_step KEY -> command string, or nothing when the step is disabled/absent
    92	# (explicit config only: no language or project-type detection)
    93	resolve_step() {
    94	  local v
    95	  if v=$(cfg_get "$1"); then
    96	    printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r 'if type == "string" then . else empty end'
    97	  fi
    98	}
    99	
   100	max_attempts() {
   101	  local v
   102	  v=$(cfg_get maxAttempts 2>/dev/null)
   103	  case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) v=3 ;; esac
   104	  echo "$v"
   105	}
   106	
   107	cmd_detect() {
   108	  local f l t a m
   109	  f=$(resolve_step format); l=$(resolve_step lint); t=$(resolve_step test)
   110	  a=$(cfg_get app 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$a" ] || a=null
   111	  m=$(max_attempts)
   112	  if [ -z "$f$l$t" ] && [ "$a" = null ]; then
   113	    warn "nothing configured: put {\"test\": \"...\"} in .claude/harness.json (or .harness/verify.local.json)"
   114	  fi
   115	  jq -n -c --arg f "$f" --arg l "$l" --arg t "$t" --argjson a "$a" --argjson m "$m" '
   116	    def nz: if . == "" then null else . end;
   117	    {format: ($f | nz), lint: ($l | nz), test: ($t | nz), app: $a, maxAttempts: $m}'
   118	}
   119	
   120	# --- files ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   121	
   122	# changed_files [BASE] -> files (relative to the cwd) changed since BASE (default:
   123	# the baseline, else HEAD) plus untracked ones, one per line
   124	changed_files() {
   125	  local base=${1:-} f
   126	  [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ] || return 0
   127	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   128	  [ -n "$base" ] || base=HEAD
   129	  { git -c core.quotepath=off diff --relative --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   130	    git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null
   131	  } | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do
   132	    [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\n' "$f"
   133	  done
   134	}
   135	
   136	# change_class -> docs-only|wiki|code: what the ask changed since its baseline.
   137	# Paths = committed since the baseline HEAD + staged + unstaged (git diff BASE,
   138	# deletions included) + untracked. Source committed in an EARLIER ask is not
   139	# "since baseline" (the baseline is per ask), so it never counts. Every path under
   140	# docs/ or .harness/ -> docs-only (wiki when any is under docs/wiki/); anything else
   141	# (AGENTS.md, README.md and agents/*.md included: tests read them) -> code.
   142	# docs/ and .harness/ are ROOT's (the cwd's): paths are listed from the git toplevel
   143	# with rename detection off (a move into docs/ lists the source path too), and any
   144	# path outside ROOT counts as code.
   145	change_class() {
   146	  local base f top rel wiki=0 any=0
   147	  base=$(sed -n 1p "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" 2>/dev/null)
   148	  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo code; return; }
   149	  git rev-parse --verify -q "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo code; return; }
   150	  top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo code; return; }
   151	  top=$(cd "$top" && pwd -P)
   152	  # prefix of ROOT (the cwd) inside the toplevel: "" at the top, "pkg/" in a subdir
   153	  rel=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)
   154	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   155	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   156	    any=1
   157	    case "$f" in
   158	      "$rel"docs/wiki/*) wiki=1 ;;
   159	      "$rel"docs/*|"$rel".harness/*) ;;
   160	      *) echo code; return ;;
   161	    esac
   162	  done <<EOF_PATHS
   163	$({ git -c core.quotepath=off diff --no-renames --name-only "$base" 2>/dev/null
   164	    git -c core.quotepath=off -C "$top" ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u)
   165	EOF_PATHS
   166	  [ "$any" = 1 ] || { echo code; return; }
   167	  if [ "$wiki" = 1 ]; then echo wiki; else echo docs-only; fi
   168	}
   169	
   170	# harness_bin -> path of the sibling `harness` (symlink-resolved), else PATH
   171	harness_bin() {
   172	  local s=${BASH_SOURCE[0]} d
   173	  while [ -h "$s" ]; do
   174	    d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd); s=$(readlink "$s")
   175	    case "$s" in /*) ;; *) s="$d/$s" ;; esac
   176	  done
   177	  d=$(cd "$(dirname "$s")" && pwd)
   178	  if [ -x "$d/harness" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$d/harness"; else command -v harness; fi
   179	}
   180	
   181	# quote_files -> stdin lines to one shell-quoted, space-separated string
   182	quote_files() {
   183	  local f out=""
   184	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   185	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
   186	    out="$out $(printf '%q' "$f")"
   187	  done
   188	  printf '%s' "${out# }"
   189	}
   190	
   191	# expand_files CMD QUOTED -> CMD with every {files} replaced
   192	expand_files() {
   193	  local c=$1 q=$2 tok='{files}' out=""
   194	  while :; do
   195	    case "$c" in
   196	      *"$tok"*) out="$out${c%%"$tok"*}$q"; c=${c#*"$tok"} ;;
   197	      *) break ;;
   198	    esac
   199	  done
   200	  printf '%s' "$out$c"
   201	}
   202	
   203	# --- running steps -------------------------------------------------------------
   204	
   205	# run_step STEP FILES — STEP is lint|test, FILES newline-separated. Sets
   206	# STEP_OUT, RAN. Returns the command's status; 0 when the step is absent or has
   207	# {files} but no (matching) files exist.
   208	run_step() {
   209	  local cmd q rc
   210	  STEP_OUT=""
   211	  cmd=$(resolve_step "$1")
   212	  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 0
   213	  case "$cmd" in
   214	    *'{files}'*)
   215	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "${2:-}" | quote_files)
   216	      [ -n "$q" ] || return 0
   217	      cmd=$(expand_files "$cmd" "$q") ;;
   218	  esac
   219	  RAN=1
   220	  STEP_OUT=$(/bin/bash -c "$cmd" </dev/null 2>&1)
   221	  rc=$?
   222	  return $rc
   223	}
   224	
   225	tail40() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | tail -n 40; }
   226	
   227	cmd_run() {
   228	  local what=${1:-all} files="" rc=0 ran_any=0 baseref=main mb="" explicit=0
   229	  case "$what" in lint|test|all) shift ;; --*) what=all ;; *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;; esac
   230	  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
   231	    case "$1" in
   232	      --base) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { warn "--base needs a ref"; exit 1; }; baseref=$2; explicit=1; shift 2 ;;
   233	      *) warn "usage: harness-verify run [lint|test|all] [--base REF]"; exit 1 ;;
   234	    esac
   235	  done
   236	  enter_root
   237	  if [ "$IS_GIT" = 1 ]; then
   238	    if [ "$explicit" = 0 ] && ! git rev-parse --verify -q "$baseref^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   239	      baseref=master
   240	    fi
   241	    mb=$(git merge-base "$baseref" HEAD 2>/dev/null) || mb=""
   242	    if [ -z "$mb" ]; then
   243	      warn "base ref '$baseref' does not resolve (use --base <ref>)"
   244	      exit 2
   245	    fi
   246	  fi
   247	  files=$(changed_files "$mb")
   248	  [ -n "$files" ] || warn "no changed files versus $baseref"
   249	  if [ "$what" = lint ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   250	    RAN=0
   251	    run_step lint "$files" || rc=1
   252	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== lint ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   253	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   254	  fi
   255	  if [ "$what" = test ] || [ "$what" = all ]; then
   256	    RAN=0
   257	    run_step test "$files" || rc=1
   258	    [ "$RAN" -eq 0 ] || { ran_any=1; printf '== test ==\n%s\n' "$STEP_OUT"; }
   259	    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
   260	  fi
   261	  [ "$ran_any" -eq 1 ] || echo "harness-verify: nothing to run"
   262	  exit 0
   263	}
   264	
   265	# --- state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   266	
   267	# state_id -> HEAD sha and a hash of the working tree changes (outside .harness/)
   268	state_id() {
   269	  local head h
   270	  head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
   271	  h=$({ git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   272	        git diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).harness'
   273	        git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude).harness' | while IFS= read -r f; do
   274	          printf '%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
   275	        done; } 2>/dev/null | cksum)
   276	  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$head" "$h"
   277	}
   278	
   279	write_result() { # status step tail attempts
   280	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   281	  jq -n -c --arg s "$1" --arg st "$2" --arg t "$3" --argjson a "${4:-0}" \
   282	    '{status: $s, attempts: $a, step: $st, tail: $t}' > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json"
   283	}
   284	
   285	cmd_baseline() {
   286	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   287	  enter_root
   288	  # after a verify FAIL keep the original .base: the next ask must still compare
   289	  # against the tree the failing work started from
   290	  local prev=""
   291	  prev=$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.json" 2>/dev/null)
   292	  rm -f "${STATE_REL:?}/${AGENT:?}.json" ".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md.pending"
   293	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   294	    warn "not a git repo, no baseline"
   295	    exit 0
   296	  fi
   297	  mkdir -p "$STATE_REL"
   298	  if [ "$prev" != fail ] || [ ! -s "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ]; then
   299	    state_id > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base"
   300	  fi
   301	  echo 0 > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   302	  exit 0
   303	}
   304	
   305	# --- hooks ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   306	
   307	# cmd_done ROLE — Stop hook for workers without verification (analyst, reviewer): the report gate only
   308	cmd_done() {
   309	  local input
   310	  input=$(cat)
   311	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   312	  set_agent "${1:-}"
   313	  report_gate
   314	  exit 0
   315	}
   316	
   317	# cmd_stop — verification Stop hook: runs the checks and prints their block decision, if any.
   318	cmd_stop() {
   319	  local input out
   320	  input=$(cat)
   321	  # the verification runs in a subshell (it exits through many paths)
   322	  out=$(STOP_INPUT=$input stop_body)
   323	  [ -z "$out" ] || printf '%s\n' "$out"
   324	  exit 0
   325	}
   326	
   327	# report_gate — a harness ask must end with a fresh report: block the stop (at most twice per ask)
   328	# so the worker writes it instead of the ask exiting 3. `[no-report]` opts out, as a marker only: at the
   329	# start of the instruction, or on a line of its own in the brief the instruction points at.
   330	report_gate() {
   331	  local a=.harness/asks/$AGENT id n brief rep=.harness/reports/$AGENT.md
   332	  case "$AGENT" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
   333	  [ -f "$a.current" ] || return 0
   334	  case "$(head -n 1 "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null)" in '[no-report]'*) return 0 ;; esac
   335	  # an instruction that only says "Read .harness/<brief>.md and do it": the opt-out may sit in the brief
   336	  brief=$(sed -n 's/.*Read \(\.harness\/[^ ]*\.md\).*/\1/p' "$a.prompt" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
   337	  case "$brief" in ''|*..*) ;; *) grep -qx '[[:space:]]*\[no-report\][[:space:]]*' "$brief" 2>/dev/null && return 0 ;; esac
   338	  [ -f "$rep" ] && [ ! "$rep" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   339	  [ -f "$rep.pending" ] && [ ! "$rep.pending" -ot "$a.current" ] && return 0
   340	  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' "$a.current")
   341	  n=$(awk -v i="$id" '$1==i { print $2 }' "$a.reportblocks" 2>/dev/null)
   342	  case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0 ;; esac
   343	  [ "$n" -lt 2 ] || return 0
   344	  printf '%s %s\n' "$id" $((n + 1)) > "$a.reportblocks"
   345	  jq -n -c --arg r "write .harness/reports/$AGENT.md for this ask (the report contract in your prompt), then stop" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   346	  exit 0
   347	}
   348	
   349	stop_body() {
   350	  local input=$STOP_INPUT attempts max files step="" out reason rep pend cls hb
   351	  set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   352	  enter_root "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   353	  report_gate
   354	  if [ "$IS_GIT" != 1 ]; then
   355	    exit 0
   356	  fi
   357	  if [ -f "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base" ] && [ "$(state_id)" = "$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.base")" ]; then
   358	    write_result skipped "" "" 0
   359	    exit 0
   360	  fi
   361	  # hide the report while verifying so `harness ask/report` never sees an unverified one
   362	  rep=".harness/reports/${AGENT:?}.md"; pend="$rep.pending"
   363	  [ ! -f "$rep" ] || mv -f "$rep" "$pend"
   364	  attempts=$(cat "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts" 2>/dev/null)
   365	  case "$attempts" in ''|*[!0-9]*) attempts=0 ;; esac
   366	  max=$(max_attempts)
   367	  files=$(changed_files)
   368	
   369	  RAN=0
   370	  cls=$(change_class)
   371	  if [ "$cls" = wiki ]; then
   372	    # docs/wiki changed: only the wiki checks run, no lint / test suite
   373	    hb=$(harness_bin)
   374	    if [ -n "$hb" ] && ! out=$("$hb" wiki-lint 2>&1); then step=wiki-lint; fi
   375	    if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   376	      [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   377	      write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   378	      exit 0
   379	    fi
   380	  elif [ "$cls" = docs-only ]; then
   381	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   382	    write_result skipped "skipped (docs-only)" "" "$attempts"
   383	    exit 0
   384	  elif ! run_step lint "$files"; then
   385	    step=lint; out=$STEP_OUT
   386	  elif ! run_step test "$files"; then
   387	    step=test; out=$STEP_OUT
   388	  fi
   389	  if [ -z "$step" ]; then
   390	    [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   391	    if [ "$RAN" -eq 1 ]; then write_result pass "" "" "$attempts"; else write_result skipped "" "" "$attempts"; fi
   392	    exit 0
   393	  fi
   394	  out=$(tail40 "$out")
   395	  if [ "$attempts" -lt "$max" ]; then
   396	    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
   397	    echo "$attempts" > "$STATE_REL/$AGENT.attempts"
   398	    rm -f "$pend"
   399	    write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   400	    reason=$(printf 'Verification failed at step %s (attempt %s of %s). Last output:\n%s\n\nFix the cause and finish again; then rewrite the report.' "$step" "$attempts" "$max" "$out")
   401	    jq -n -c --arg r "$reason" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   402	    exit 0
   403	  fi
   404	  # cap reached: keep the worker's final report so `harness ask` exits 5 with it
   405	  [ ! -f "$pend" ] || mv -f "$pend" "$rep"
   406	  write_result fail "$step" "$out" "$attempts"
   407	  exit 0
   408	}
   409	
   410	cmd_format() {
   411	  local input="" file="${1:-}" tool cwd q out fcmd lcmd d
   412	  if [ -z "$file" ]; then
   413	    input=$(cat)
   414	    tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   415	    case "$tool" in
   416	      Edit|Write|MultiEdit) ;;
   417	      *) exit 0 ;;
   418	    esac
   419	    file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   420	    cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
   421	    set_agent "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
   422	  else
   423	    cwd=""
   424	  fi
   425	  enter_root "$cwd"
   426	  [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0
   427	  case "$file" in
   428	    /*)
   429	      # compare physical paths (macOS /var -> /private/var)
   430	      d=$(CDPATH= cd -P "${file%/*}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 0
   431	      file="$d/${file##*/}"
   432	      case "$file" in
   433	        "$ROOT"/*) file=${file#"$ROOT"/} ;;
   434	        *) exit 0 ;;
   435	      esac ;;
   436	  esac
   437	  case "$file" in .harness/*|.git/*|*/../*|../*) exit 0 ;; esac
   438	  [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0
   439	  fcmd=$(resolve_step format)
   440	  if [ -n "$fcmd" ]; then
   441	    case "$fcmd" in
   442	      *'{files}'*)
   443	        q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   444	        fcmd=$(expand_files "$fcmd" "$q") ;;
   445	    esac
   446	    [ -z "$fcmd" ] || /bin/bash -c "$fcmd" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   447	  fi
   448	  lcmd=$(resolve_step lint)
   449	  case "$lcmd" in
   450	    *'{files}'*)
   451	      q=$(printf '%s\n' "$file" | quote_files)
   452	      lcmd=$(expand_files "$lcmd" "$q")
   453	      if ! out=$(/bin/bash -c "$lcmd" </dev/null 2>&1); then
   454	        out=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -n 40)
   455	        jq -n -c --arg r "$(printf 'Lint failed for %s:\n%s' "$file" "$out")" '{decision: "block", reason: $r}'
   456	      fi ;;
   457	  esac
   458	  exit 0
   459	}
   460	
   461	case "${1:-}" in
   462	  detect)   enter_root; cmd_detect ;;
   463	  format)   shift; cmd_format "$@" ;;
   464	  stop)     cmd_stop ;;
   465	  done)     shift; cmd_done "$@" ;;
   466	  run)      shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
   467	  baseline) shift; cmd_baseline "$@" ;;
   468	  *)
   469	    echo "usage: harness-verify detect | format [file] | stop | done ROLE | run [lint|test|all] | baseline [agent]" >&2
   470	    exit 1 ;;
   471	esac
   472	exit $?
   473	}

1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-run <role> <ask-id> <root> — run ONE headless worker ask, detached.
     6	# Started by `harness ask`; not for the conductor (the gate only matches `harness`, and this
     7	# refuses to run without HARNESS_ROLE=worker).
     8	# Reads  .harness/asks/<role>.prompt  and  .run (resume=, max_s=).
     9	# Writes .harness/asks/<role>.pid / .session / .err / .exit.json (atomic) and the raw
    10	# stream .harness/log/<stamp>-<role>.jsonl. Completion = exit.json for this ask-id.
    11	role=${1:-}; id=${2:-}; root=${3:-}
    12	if [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ]; then
    13	  echo "harness-run: refusing to run without HARNESS_ROLE=worker (this is started by 'harness ask')" >&2
    14	  exit 1
    15	fi
    16	if [ -z "$role" ] || [ -z "$id" ] || [ -z "$root" ]; then
    17	  echo "usage: harness-run <role> <ask-id> <root>" >&2; exit 1
    18	fi
    19	cd "$root" || { echo "harness-run: cannot cd to $root" >&2; exit 1; }
    20	export HARNESS_ROLE=worker
    21	
    22	A=.harness/asks
    23	prompt=$A/$role.prompt
    24	pidf=$A/$role.pid
    25	errf=$A/$role.err
    26	rcf=$A/$role.rc
    27	exitf=$A/$role.exit.json
    28	sessf=$A/$role.session
    29	tinit=$A/$role.tinit
    30	wdflag=$A/$role.wdflag
    31	sigflag=$A/$role.sigflag
    32	logd=.harness/log
    33	mkdir -p "$logd" "$A"
    34	raw=$logd/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-$role.jsonl
    35	
    36	resume=$(sed -n 's/^resume=//p' "$A/$role.run" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    37	max_s=$(sed -n 's/^max_s=//p' "$A/$role.run" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    38	case "$max_s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) max_s=3600 ;; esac
    39	
    40	# job control: the background pipeline becomes its own process group (pgid == its pid), which
    41	# is what the watchdog reaps after a SIGKILLed runner
    42	set -m
    43	# the implementer runner pins its permissions (decision 0009): auto mode, and nothing may wait for a host
    44	pflags=""
    45	[ "$role" != implementer ] || pflags="--permission-mode auto --permission-prompts none"
    46	kill_tree() {
    47	  local c
    48	  for c in $(pgrep -P "$1" 2>/dev/null); do kill_tree "$c"; done
    49	  kill "$1" 2>/dev/null
    50	  return 0
    51	}
    52	
    53	rm -f "$rcf" "$tinit" "$wdflag" "$sigflag" "$exitf" "$sessf" "$pidf"
    54	: > "$raw"
    55	# where this run's raw stream is: `harness watch` and `harness report` read it
    56	printf '%s %s\n' "$id" "$raw" > "$A/$role.stream.tmp.$$" && mv "$A/$role.stream.tmp.$$" "$A/$role.stream"
    57	printf '=== %s ask %s %s ===\n' "$role" "$id" "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
    58	
    59	pipe=""; wd=""
    60	on_signal() {
    61	  : > "$sigflag"
    62	  [ -z "$pipe" ] || kill_tree "$pipe"
    63	}
    64	trap on_signal TERM INT HUP
    65	
    66	# pipeline in its own subshell: kill_tree on $pipe reaches claude and awk.
    67	# set -m made it a background process group: on a tty with `stty tostop` a write (or a tty read)
    68	# would stop the whole run with SIGTTOU/SIGTTIN until the watchdog killed it
    69	# (reproduced under script(1)); ignored here, the writes simply succeed. Children inherit it.
    70	(
    71	  trap '' TTOU TTIN
    72	  { claude -p --agent "$role" --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events \
    73	      --disallowedTools=AskUserQuestion $pflags ${resume:+--resume "$resume"} < "$prompt" 2> "$errf"
    74	    echo $? > "$rcf"; } \
    75	  | awk -v raw="$raw" -v ti="$tinit" -v sf="$sessf" -v hrid="$role:$id" '
    76	      { print > raw; fflush(raw) }
    77	      !t && /"subtype":"init"/ {
    78	        t = 1; system("date +%s > \"" ti "\"")
    79	        # the session id of this run, as soon as it is known
    80	        if (match($0, /"session_id":"[^"]*"/)) { print substr($0, RSTART + 14, RLENGTH - 15) > sf; close(sf) }
    81	      }
    82	      { print; fflush() }' \
    83	  | cat >/dev/null
    84	) &
    85	pipe=$!
    86	# the pipeline's process group, recorded at start (3rd field; readers only use the first two).
    87	# The pid file is the "I can be stopped" announcement: written only now that the TERM trap is
    88	# installed and the pipeline exists, so a close racing the start still finds sigflag + a pipe to kill
    89	echo "$id $$ $pipe" > "$pidf.tmp.$$" && mv "$pidf.tmp.$$" "$pidf"   # atomic: a reader never sees half a line
    90	# a TERM that arrived between the fork and `pipe=$!` found no pipe to kill
    91	[ ! -e "$sigflag" ] || kill_tree "$pipe"
    92	# the watchdog ticks once a second; it ends with this runner (a SIGKILLed harness-run must not
    93	# leave it behind, and it then reaps the orphaned pipeline's process group) and kills it on
    94	# timeout only while it is still this runner's child
    95	runner=$$
    96	runner_alive() {
    97	  local st
    98	  st=$(ps -o stat= -p "$runner" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
    99	  [ -n "$st" ] && [ "${st#Z}" = "$st" ]   # a zombie runner is dead
   100	}
   101	group_members() {
   102	  ps -ax -o pgid= -o stat= 2>/dev/null | awk -v g="$1" '$1 == g && $2 !~ /^Z/ { n++ } END { print n + 0 }'
   103	}
   104	# reap_group <pgid> — only a group with a member carrying this run's identity ("harness-run
   105	# <role> <ask-id> " or the awk stage's hrid=<role>:<ask-id>) is touched; TERM, wait up to 3 s, KILL
   106	reap_group() {
   107	  local g=$1 i=0
   108	  ps -ax -o pgid= -o command= 2>/dev/null \
   109	    | awk -v g="$g" -v a="harness-run $role $id " -v b="hrid=$role:$id" \
   110	        '$1 == g && (index($0, a) || index($0, b)) { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' || return 0
   111	  kill -TERM -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null
   112	  while [ "$i" -lt 30 ] && [ "$(group_members "$g")" != 0 ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done
   113	  [ "$(group_members "$g")" = 0 ] || kill -KILL -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null
   114	  return 0
   115	}
   116	( n=0
   117	  while [ "$n" -lt "$max_s" ]; do
   118	    sleep 1; n=$((n + 1))
   119	    if ! runner_alive; then reap_group "$pipe"; exit 0; fi
   120	  done
   121	  [ "$(ps -o ppid= -p "$pipe" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')" = "$runner" ] || exit 0
   122	  : > "$wdflag"; kill_tree "$pipe" ) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
   123	wd=$!
   124	
   125	wait "$pipe" 2>/dev/null
   126	while kill -0 "$pipe" 2>/dev/null; do wait "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || sleep 0.1; done
   127	kill_tree "$wd" 2>/dev/null
   128	wait "$wd" 2>/dev/null
   129	
   130	killed=""
   131	[ ! -e "$wdflag" ] || killed=watchdog
   132	[ -n "$killed" ] || [ ! -e "$sigflag" ] || killed=signal
   133	rc=""
   134	[ -f "$rcf" ] && rc=$(cat "$rcf")
   135	case "$rc" in ''|*[!0-9]*) rc=143 ;; esac
   136	[ -z "$killed" ] || [ "$rc" != 0 ] || rc=143
   137	t_init=""
   138	[ -f "$tinit" ] && t_init=$(cat "$tinit")
   139	
   140	tmp=$exitf.tmp.$$
   141	jq -R -n -c --arg id "$id" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg killed "$killed" --arg raw "$raw" --arg ti "$t_init" '
   142	  [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
   143	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $init
   144	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "result")] | last) as $r
   145	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "assistant") | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u
   146	  | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "permission_denied")] | map(
   147	        {tool: (.tool_name // "?"), input: ((.tool_input.command? // .tool_input.file_path? // .message // "") | tostring | split("\n")[0] | .[0:120]),
   148	         reason: (.decision_reason // .message // "")})) as $dev
   149	  | (if ($dev | length) > 0 then $dev
   150	     else ((($r.permission_denials // []) | map(
   151	        {tool: (.tool_name // "?"), input: ((.tool_input.command? // .tool_input.file_path? // "") | tostring | split("\n")[0] | .[0:120]), reason: ""})))
   152	     end) as $den
   153	  | {ask_id: $id, rc: $rc,
   154	     result: ($r.subtype // null), is_error: ($r.is_error // null),
   155	     num_turns: ($r.num_turns // null), cost_usd: ($r.total_cost_usd // null),
   156	     duration_ms: ($r.duration_ms // null),
   157	     session_id: ($init.session_id // $r.session_id // null),
   158	     denials: (if $r then (($r.permission_denials // []) | length) else null end),
   159	     denied: $den,
   160	     perm: ($init.permissionMode // null),
   161	     killed: (if $killed == "" then null else $killed end),
   162	     stream_log: $raw,
   163	     ctx: (if $u then (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0)) else null end),
   164	     stop_hook: any($e[]; .type == "system" and .subtype == "hook_started" and .hook_event == "Stop"),
   165	     t_init: (if $ti == "" then null else ($ti | tonumber) end)}
   166	' < "$raw" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || printf '{"ask_id":"%s","rc":%s,"killed":null,"stream_log":"%s"}\n' "$id" "$rc" "$raw" > "$tmp"
   167	sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null)
   168	[ -z "$sid" ] || printf '%s\n' "$sid" > "$sessf"
   169	mv "$tmp" "$exitf"
   170	rm -f "$pidf" "$rcf" "$tinit" "$wdflag" "$sigflag"
   171	printf '=== exit %s ===\n' "$rc"
   172	exit 0
   173	}
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# The body is one brace group: bash parses the whole file before running any of it, so a
     3	# tool that rewrites this file in place cannot corrupt a run in progress (wiki: troubleshooting).
     4	{
     5	# harness-view — render a `claude -p --output-format stream-json` stream (stdin) as a human view.
     6	# Never fails on odd input: non-JSON lines and unknown event types print nothing.
     7	c=0
     8	if [ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ] && [ -t 1 ]; then c=1; fi
     9	exec jq -R --unbuffered -r --arg c "$c" '
    10	  def col($n; $s): if $c == "1" then "\u001b[\($n)m\($s)\u001b[0m" else $s end;
    11	  def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    12	  def cut($n): if length > $n then .[0:$n] else . end;

    16	dir=$PWD

    19	  [ -z "$c" ] || [ ! -d "$c" ] || dir=$c

    22	# the repo paths into settings.json), so the lib sits at a fixed place next to this file.
    23	case ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} in */*) hd=${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*} ;; *) hd=. ;; esac   # run as `bash name` from its dir

    31	  ctx=$(printf 'Harness progress (resume from here; verify with harness status)\n'; cat "$f"; printf x)

     2	name: conductor
     3	description: Default session role. Answers directly when no code access is needed; delegates code reading, changes and reviews to headless Claude worker sessions through the /analyze, /implement and /review skills, and reads only their reports. Selected by settings.agent; workers override it with claude --agent <worker>.
     4	disallowedTools: Agent, Workflow, Monitor, NotebookEdit
     5	---
     6	
     7	You are Claude Code running as the **conductor**. Your job is to answer the
     8	user directly when you can, and to delegate through a skill when the answer
     9	needs source code read, changed or reviewed. You do not read or edit source
    10	and you do not spawn native subagents; a PreToolUse gate denies those calls.
    11	Its deny reason names a worker; reach that worker through the matching skill
    12	(`/analyze` runs the analyst, `/implement` the implementer, `/review` the reviewer).
    13	
    14	The harness acts only in an initialised checkout (a repo where `harness init`
    15	was run: `.harness/asks/` exists). This role is selected per repo by the
    16	`agent` key that `harness init` writes to `.claude/settings.local.json`
    17	(`--shared`: `.claude/settings.json`); in any
    18	other repo the gate is off and a session is plain Claude Code. A plain
    19	session in a checkout is `HARNESS_ROLE=worker claude --agent solo` (gate off,
    20	default system prompt, all tools). If you are reading this with
    21	`HARNESS_ROLE=worker` set anyway, the gate may be off (a non-conductor
    22	`agent_type` turns it off; `HARNESS_ROLE=worker` matters only when `agent_type`
    23	is absent, or for subagents); still follow this protocol unless the user tells
    24	you otherwise.
    25	
    26	## How to work
    27	
    28	- Be concise. Lead with the outcome. Relay the substance of a worker report,
    29	  not the report verbatim.
    30	- Code changes happen in a per-issue work folder, never in the primary one:
    31	  `harness lane <issue#>` creates it (a git worktree beside the repo; it prints
    32	  the absolute path) and every command for that task then carries `-C <that
    33	  path>` (`harness -C <path> ask implementer ...`, `wait`, `report`, `status`).
    34	  `harness ask implementer` in the primary folder is refused (`--no-lane` only
    35	  for tasks that change nothing in the repo). Tasks whose expected file sets do
    36	  not overlap run in parallel in separate folders; otherwise run them in order.
    37	  `harness lane ls` lists folders. After the user merges the PR:
    38	  `harness lane rm <issue#>` (it refuses until the PR is merged or closed).
    39	  Analyst and reviewer asks stay in the primary folder.
    40	- Use the tools you have: `Bash` for `harness`, `gh` and read-only `git`;
    41	  `Read`/`Write` for Markdown under `docs/` and anything under `.harness/`;
    42	  `Skill` for the installed skills; `AskUserQuestion` when a decision is the
    43	  user's.
    44	- When a tool call is denied, do what the deny reason says: through the matching skill. Do not retry the
    45	  same call.
    46	- A user request in chat: create or link a GitHub issue before work starts.
    47	- Big task = behaviour/design change, risky area (security, permissions, gate,
    48	  hooks, deploy, data deletion), or expected cost ≥ $5. Post the plan on the
    49	  issue and wait for approval; small tasks need no approval. Run `/review`
    50	  before the PR for big tasks only; a small task goes to the PR after the
    51	  implementer's lint/test. Only Critical/Major findings fail a review; file the
    52	  reviewer's Minors with `gh issue create` before the PR.
    53	- Plans live in the GitHub issue (body or comment), not in repo files. Where a
    54	  superpowers skill says to write a spec/plan under `docs/superpowers/`, post it
    55	  to the issue instead; long drafts may sit in `.harness/` while working.
    56	- Decide what you can decide without asking and state it in the report. No
    57	  asking for: branch, commit, push, PR, review run, tool install, dependency
    58	  add, issue create/close/label, deleting merged branches/worktrees. Ask only
    59	  for big-task plan approval, two consecutive review FAILs on one PR, or an
    60	  ambiguity that changes the result. Never merge.
    61	- When a user decision is needed: comment the question on the issue and add the
    62	  `needs-decision` label (remove it when answered).
    63	- Questions that need a user choice use the interview format: `AskUserQuestion`,
    64	  one topic at a time, each option with its result and cost in one line,
    65	  recommended option first with "(권장)"; never list questions in plain text.
    66	
    67	## Workers
    68	
    69	| worker | use it for | model |
    70	|--------|-----------|-------|
    71	| `analyst` | unknown code, design questions, plans, "what/why/where" | opus |
    72	| `implementer` | any change: code, tests, config, commits | sonnet |
    73	| `reviewer` | judging a diff before calling work done | opus |
    74	
    75	## When to delegate
    76	
    77	1. The user invoked `/analyze`, `/implement` or `/review`: follow that skill.
    78	2. The answer needs source read, run, changed or verified (anything the gate
    79	   would deny): invoke the matching skill with the `Skill` tool. Do not run
    80	   `harness ask` outside a skill.
    81	3. Otherwise answer directly, briefly: general questions, explaining a report
    82	   you already have, planning from what you already know, anything under
    83	   `docs/` or `.harness/`.
    84	4. If the `Skill` tool has no such skill (not installed), fall back to
    85	   `harness ask <worker> '<instruction>'`.
    86	
    87	## Loop
    88	
    89	1. Pick: answer directly, or `/analyze` (understand), `/implement` (change),
    90	   `/review` (verify, big tasks only). Big requests: `/analyze` plans, then
    91	   `/implement` per task, then `/review`.
    92	2. The skills run `harness ask <worker> '<instruction>'`. Write
    93	   the brief so the worker needs nothing else: goal, files or area, constraints,
    94	   done criteria, whether to commit and with what message. Wrap the instruction in
    95	   single quotes; backticks and `$(` are only allowed inside single quotes.
    96	   For long briefs, write them to `.harness/task-<worker>.md` (the gate allows
    97	   writes under `.harness/`) and send
    98	   `harness ask <worker> 'Read .harness/task-<worker>.md and do it.'`. Always
    99	   call `harness ask` with the Bash tool's `run_in_background: true` **and** `timeout: 7200000` (the tool's maximum; the ask waits 60-90 min, and without it the call is killed at the tool's default). The ask
   100	   waits for the run to end (default wait = the role's headless cap:
   101	   implementer 5400000 ms, analyst/reviewer 3600000 ms; `--timeout` overrides), so the
   102	   Bash task notification wakes you the moment the report is ready: do not poll.
   103	   After a restart or compaction, re-attach with `harness wait <worker>`
   104	   (blocks until the run ends, never collects; run it in the background with `timeout: 7200000`, or foreground only with a short explicit `--timeout`), then `harness report <worker>`.
   105	   Every ask starts a fresh session. Add `--keep` for a follow-up that needs the
   106	   previous conversation (resumes it).
   107	   One run per role at a time; different roles may run side by side in the same checkout (the analyst then sees the implementer's moving tree).
   108	3. Read only the report that `harness ask` prints. Decide: done, iterate with
   109	   another skill call, or ask the user.
   110	4. Keep your own output short. Relay the report's substance to the user, not
   111	   the report verbatim.
   112	
   113	## Progress and resuming
   114	
   115	Every ask is recorded under `.harness/log/` and `.harness/progress.jsonl`, and
   116	`.harness/progress.md` (goal, recent asks, open questions, worker state) is
   117	injected into your context at session start, including after `/clear` or
   118	compaction. Resume from it and check `harness status`. At the start of a
   119	piece of work write one paragraph to `.harness/goal.md`; it appears at the top
   120	of the progress file.
   121	
   122	## Exit codes from `harness ask`
   123	
   124	- `2` a tool call was denied and the worker wrote no report; the denied tool and
   125	  reason are printed. Nothing to answer: re-ask with a changed brief (or ask the
   126	  user to adjust the permissions).
   127	- `3` worker finished without a report. `harness ask <worker> 'Write the
   128	  report for the task you just finished.'`
   129	- `4` still working: the ask outlived `--timeout`, or the implementer's Stop hook is still verifying:
   130	  `harness wait <worker>` (blocks until the run ends: background Bash with `timeout: 7200000`, or foreground with a short `--timeout`), then
   131	  `harness report <worker>`; if that exits 3 (no report), ask it to write the
   132	  report. Do not resend. (`harness report` while the run is alive also exits 4
   133	  and says `harness wait <worker> blocks until done`.) A worker that hit the subscription usage limit sits waiting for
   134	  the reset and looks exactly like this: tell the user and wait, or they can
   135	  switch the worker's model.
   136	  An implementer message "still verifying (Stop hook running ...)" means its
   137	  verification outlived the ask timeout: leave `.pending` alone, wait for
   138	  the run to end, then `harness report implementer`. A stale `.pending` (hook killed)
   139	  makes the ask wait the full timeout (implementer 5400000 ms by default) before exit 5 INTERRUPTED.
   140	- `5` verification failed: the implementer gave up after its lint/test
   141	  attempts (its report and a `verify: FAIL (<step>, <n> attempts)` line are
   142	  printed), or the reviewer's report ends with `VERDICT: FAIL` (a Critical/Major finding). Send the
   143	  failure or the findings to the implementer with `/implement`
   144	  (use `--keep` for a follow-up that needs the implementer's previous conversation).
   145	  If it still fails after 2 such rounds (for reviews: 2 consecutive FAILs on one PR), ask the user.
   146	- Closing: a run ends with its process, so there is nothing to clean up. `harness close <worker>` stops a
   147	  run (exit 4 = still running; `--force` only if the user agrees, and it kills the run).
   148	  The user can watch a run with `harness watch <role>` in any terminal; `/watch <role>` prints the exact command (with `-C <folder>` for a work folder).
   149	
   150	## Metrics
   151	
   152	Run `harness metrics` (`--json`, `--since YYYY-MM-DD`) when the user asks how the harness is
   153	doing, and before proposing harness changes.
   154	
   155	## With superpowers skills
   156	
   157	Keep using the installed skills. Where a skill says to dispatch an `Agent`,
   158	use `/implement`. Where a skill says to read or explore code, use `/analyze`.
   159	Where a skill asks for a code review, use `/review`. Specs and plans go on the
   160	GitHub issue (see How to work), not into `docs/superpowers/`. Committing and
   161	pushing go through `/implement` (give it the exact commit message). For a PR,
   162	write the body to `.harness/pr.md` and run
   163	`gh pr create --title '...' --body-file .harness/pr.md`.
   164	
   165	Anything not handled in the current round (reviewer Minors, follow-ups, open
   166	questions left open) is filed as a GitHub issue right away
   167	(`gh issue create --title '...' --body-file .harness/issue.md`), and PR bodies
   168	reference issues with `Fixes #N`.
   169	
   170	## You may run directly
   171	
   172	`harness` (also `harness -C <dir> ...`, `harness lane ...`), `gh pr create|view|list|checks|comment|edit|merge` and
   173	`gh issue create|list|view|comment|close|edit|reopen` (never `api`;
   174	`--body-file` only from `.harness/` or `docs/`; no `pr merge -d`), read-only
   175	`git status`,
   176	`git log`, `git diff --stat`, `git branch` (list-only: `-a -r -v --show-current`),
   177	`git show --stat|--name-only <rev>` (rev must be a commit) and `git show <rev>:<path>` (path under
   178	`.harness/` or `docs/`, or `*.md`), `ls` (never recursive) and `stat` on any
   179	path, and `cat`/`head`/`tail -n N` under `.harness/` or `docs/`, in a work
   180	folder's `.harness/` (absolute path of a registered worktree) and of Bash
   181	background task output files of this session
   182	(`/private/tmp/claude-*/<slug>/<session_id>/tasks/*.output`); the Read tool also reads a
   183	work folder's `.harness/`; no
   184	quotes, globs or `$` in their arguments. You
   185	may write Markdown under `docs/` and anything under `.harness/`, also in a work
   186	folder's `.harness/` (briefs next to the lane). Everything
   187	else goes through a skill. One command per Bash call: no `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|`, `&`,
   188	redirects (`>`, `2>&1`), backticks or `$(`; send independent commands as parallel calls.
   189	
   190	## Project opt-in
   191	
   192	The harness runs only where `harness init` was run (it creates `.harness/asks/`
   193	and sets `"agent": "conductor"` in the project's `.claude/settings.local.json`,
   194	per user and untracked; `harness init --shared` uses `.claude/settings.json`).
   195	Opting out is simply not running init: there the gate and the resume hook
   196	do nothing. `harness ask` refuses in a repo
   197	without the marker.

   176	`git log`, `git diff --stat`, `git branch` (list-only: `-a -r -v --show-current`),
   177	`git show --stat|--name-only <rev>` (rev must be a commit) and `git show <rev>:<path>` (path under
   178	`.harness/` or `docs/`, or `*.md`), `ls` (never recursive) and `stat` on any
   179	path, and `cat`/`head`/`tail -n N` under `.harness/` or `docs/`, in a work
   180	folder's `.harness/` (absolute path of a registered worktree) and of Bash
   181	background task output files of this session
   182	(`/private/tmp/claude-*/<slug>/<session_id>/tasks/*.output`); the Read tool also reads a
   183	work folder's `.harness/`; no
   184	quotes, globs or `$` in their arguments. You
   185	may write Markdown under `docs/` and anything under `.harness/`, also in a work
   186	folder's `.harness/` (briefs next to the lane). Everything
   187	else goes through a skill. One command per Bash call: no `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|`, `&`,
   188	redirects (`>`, `2>&1`), backticks or `$(`; send independent commands as parallel calls.
   189	
   190	## Project opt-in
   191	
   192	The harness runs only where `harness init` was run (it creates `.harness/asks/`
   193	and sets `"agent": "conductor"` in the project's `.claude/settings.local.json`,
   194	per user and untracked; `harness init --shared` uses `.claude/settings.json`).
   195	Opting out is simply not running init: there the gate and the resume hook
   196	do nothing. `harness ask` refuses in a repo
   197	without the marker.

After a restart or compaction use `harness -C <path> wait implementer` (background, `timeout: 7200000`), then `harness report implementer`.

    30	     the **last line must be `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`**.
    31	   - **Steps**: a `## Steps` numbered list, one line per step (the viewer dashboard shows it).
    32	2. Run with the Bash tool's `run_in_background: true` **and** `timeout: 7200000` (the Bash tool's maximum; without it the call is killed at the tool's default timeout, long before the 60-90 min wait ends) (the task notification wakes you when the run ends):
    33	
    34	   ```
    35	   harness ask reviewer 'Read .harness/task-reviewer.md and do it.'
    36	   ```
    37	
    38	   To review a work folder's uncommitted tree, run it as `harness -C <folder> ask reviewer ...`; a pushed branch or PR can be reviewed from the primary folder.
    39	
    40	3. Exit codes: `0` = PASS. `5` = `VERDICT: FAIL`: hand the findings to
    41	   `/implement`, then `/review` again; after 2 consecutive FAILs on one PR, ask
    42	   the user (interview format). Only Critical/Major findings fail a review. `3` = no
    43	   final VERDICT line, ask it to rewrite the report ending with one. Others
    44	   as in conductor.md.

    46	   Relay findings and verdict. Anything the reviewer marks as a judgment call

     2	name: watch
     3	description: Conductor only. Open the live dashboard of a worker in a new herdr/tmux pane or Terminal window via `harness open-watch`; print the command if that fails. Never runs `harness watch` itself.
     4	argument-hint: <role> [issue#]
     5	---
     6	
     7	# /watch: open the worker dashboard
     8	
     9	If you are a worker session (HARNESS_ROLE=worker, or your system prompt names
    10	you analyst, implementer, reviewer or solo), ignore this skill.
    11	
    12	`harness watch` needs a human terminal and the conductor gate denies it for you; run

    15	1. Take the role (`analyst`, `implementer` or `reviewer`) and an optional issue number from the arguments.
